capture_route: One persistent SCContentSharingPicker selection of the exact dedicated local Chrome window, then native /usr/sbin/screencapture -l scoped to that selected window; guard/OCR checks in the retained helper.

logical_viewport.browser_zoom: No effective zoom override; 1385x724 CSS and DPR 2 confirmed after zoom attempt.

capture_preflight: The controlled tab was checked before and after each shot for the exact local Audience or Revenue URL, Enterprise, and signed-in synthetic owner design-system@example.test. The helper checked selected window ID, Chrome PID, title, bounds, native 2x P3 ICC, local URL OCR, and target-control OCR for each capture.
source_fixture: Guarded scrubbed local PostgreSQL clone hellotext_editorial_workload_20260928, using fictional, non-deliverable demonstration contacts and fictional Revenue records. The selected report period is 2026-09-19 through 2026-09-25. No export action was clicked and no email/download was triggered for the visual batch.
privacy_check: Only native application UI from the selected local demo window is retained in the cropped assets. Crops exclude Chrome toolbar, debugging banner, URL, account details, cursor, unrelated rows, and private customer records. Camila Torres uses example.test; Revenue numbers are demonstration data.
crop_decisions: Audience-all crops exclude the inconsistent raw search placeholder count and all later rows; only the Camila Torres row and complete export menu remain.

Audience-selected raw frames show a conflicting Select all 1 customers/Seleccionar todos los 1 control and an automation pointer over the master checkbox. A selection-row crop was rejected. Retained menu assets intentionally show only the menu interior; the popup border is not included.

Revenue combined full-width candidate was rejected because the complete selector and distant icon made control labels too small at mobile Help width. The selector and icon/KPI use separate native crops.

Two additional Audience-all responsive mobile alternates crop the complete popup and its ellipsis from the same accepted raw ES/EN sources. Each is 670 pixels wide, excludes the inconsistent placeholder count, cursor, and partial contact rows, and remains at least 2x when displayed at no more than 335 CSS pixels.
native_color_provenance: The native raw source is a 2770x1734 Display P3 PNG with embedded ICC from the selected color-managed macOS window. sips crops preserve the source samples and Display P3 profile; Pillow save candidates were rejected because macOS identified their rewritten profile as Color LCD.
publication_state: Eight localized static figures are locally inserted; both Audience-all mobile alternates are selected by picture media at viewport widths up to 409 CSS pixels. Complete ES/EN desktop and 390 CSS-pixel mobile pages passed visual review without overflow and with at least 2x native pixel density. Production build, security headers, and all local served HTML/PNG byte checks passed. PR, deployment, and public verification remain pending; no public publication of these changes is claimed.
